title: First tunes learned; taking up the trumpet for his daughter's school band
summary: He cannot recall his first ukulele or banjo tunes, but remembers learning trumpet on Sister Kate after buying a horn for his daughter, about 1938.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: What's the first tune you learned on ukulele?
What about guitar and banjo? What are the first tunes you learned on that? You don't remember?
My first piece on the trumpet, I remember that clearly. My first piece on the trumpet was, Wish I Could See Me Like My Sister Kate.
When did you take up the trumpet?

After, I brought the trumpet for my daughter to play in school, and the school band never did a car. So, I started running the scales, CD, FG, and I'd pick out pieces, and that's how I started playing the trumpet. That was about, hmm.
Well, we figured out how old was she then?
She must have been about, well, eight or nine years ago.

So, 8 and 29, okay. 8 or 9 and 29. It'll be about 38, maybe, something like that. Could have been about that. Yeah, yeah, well, you can figure those things out from those landmarks, you know, like that. Oh, yeah. Everybody has landmarks in their life. That's right. Uh, well, let's see. Those early bands before Desdune, who was in some of them that you played with? Even non-professional jobs when you just played for fun, maybe.
